cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me write this complaint. I taught you to separate spelling from substance; don't polish out what I'm angry about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was only correcting your spelling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're catching errors I missed now. Good. Leave the sentence about the landlord ignoring us; I want you beside me on this, not marking my homework.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quite a good sentence. I'd keep it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put both our names under it. No 'on behalf of'. You used to bring me your drafts for approval; this one goes out from two colleagues.

reason: Use specific shared tuition to change how A pursues the exact Drive. Preserve practical offers and concerns from B, and make A5 a playable response rather than a summary of the relationship mechanism.
